text: {"lessons":["I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a position; reassess it on its merits, not its purchase price.","Selling some Stock E after a large gain and adding to the other stocks did not prevent later portfolio declines; diversification helps manage risk but cannot eliminate losses.","After leaving the portfolio untouched through several strong months, I also held through a sustained downturn; I should review exposure deliberately rather than assume either staying inactive or reacting to every move is best."]}
